What's on your mind?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I just found out I missed out on the overseas promotion I was offered a while back."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Oh no, that's really disappointing, especially after having been offered it. How are you feeling about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, I feel a bit betrayed. No one even told me; I just found out through the grapevine."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really tough, Jane. It's hard to be left out of the loop like that. How are you coping with all these emotions?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I'm trying to process it, but it's hard not to feel like it's a reflection of my value at work."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to feel that way. Your work and contributions are valuable, even if it doesn't feel like it right now. Do you want to talk more about what led to this?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I think it's a combination of things. There was so much going on—my anxiety, all the financial stress, and then this on top of it."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's a lot to deal with, for sure. It reminds me of when you were considering the promotion and feeling overwhelmed. Do you think those feelings had an impact?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Maybe. I was really torn about the decision, fearing how it would affect my relationship with Eliza and just leaving everything behind."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's such a big decision with lots of factors to weigh. It makes sense that it took a toll on you. How are you feeling about your relationship with Eliza now, after everything?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"We’ve been better. We managed to patch things up after the wedding planning fallout, but I wonder how she’d have reacted if I moved."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like your bond with her is important to you. Maybe those fears were valid, but it's good to hear you've reconciled. How do you see your career moving forward after this setback?"}]
